Definition: Eliab, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Eliab = "my God is father" or "God is father"; 1) son of Helon, leader of Zebulun in the wilderness; 2) a Reubenite chief, father of Dathan and Abiram; 3) David's oldest brother; 4) a Levite musician; 5) a Gadite warrior for David; 6) a Kohathite
